        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            to E.164 form; a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true on create, allows registering this owner even if another
            owner already has the same last name and postal address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) because they share a household.
            Otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Request-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        errors:
          title: Errors
          description: Names of the request fields that failed validation.
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          example:
            - city
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - errors
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.

          format: int32
          minimum: 0

          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            to E.164 form; a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true on create, allows registering this owner even if another
            owner already has the same last name and postal address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) because they share a household.
            Otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Request-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

        - address
        - city
        - telephone

## What was implemented

`namesakeCount` on an owner = the number of existing owners (before this create) sharing the same `firstName` **and** `lastName`, compared case-insensitively. It's computed at create time on `POST /api/owners`, persisted, and returned via `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

## Files changed

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `namesakeCount` (`integer`, `readOnly`, `minimum: 0`) property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — added the `namesake_count` JPA column with getter/setter.

3. **`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — added a `countNamesakes(owner)` helper (reusing the existing `normalizeHouseholdField` for case-insensitive comparison) and set `owner.setNamesakeCount(...)` just before saving, alongside the existing `customerCode`/`householdId` logic. Because the count runs over `findAllOwners()` before the new owner is saved, it reflects only pre-existing owners.

4. **Schema files** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — added the `namesake_count` column (tests run on `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the SQL schema is authoritative).

5. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — the seed inserts use positional `VALUES` with no column list, so I appended a trailing `NULL` for the new column to keep the counts aligned (this was the cause of the initial "row column count mismatch"). h2/postgres seed inserts use explicit column lists and needed no change.

MapStruct auto-maps the matching `namesakeCount` property between `Owner` and `OwnerDto`, so no mapper edit was needed.

Test result: `AcceptanceTest.coreCountsNamesakes` passes (asserts `namesakeCount == 1` for the second of two same-name owners), full suite green — `BUILD SUCCESS`.
